Bachelor of Science Exercise Science Pre-Physical Therapy Concentration

  • You are here →
  • Course Catalog
  • Exercise Science
  • bachelor-exercise-science-pre-physical-therapy

  Download Catalog as PDF

The Exercise Science program provides students with knowledge and skills related to human movement, health, and performance. Throughout the course of the program, students will be educated about how physical activity, nutrition, and lifestyle choices contribute to overall health. The major will prepare students for advanced study in athletic training and physical therapy. The field offers practical skills for improving physical performance and recovery, enhancing patient care and athletic performance.  

Program Learning Outcomes

  1. Students will utilize and apply fundamental exercise physiology and biomechanical knowledge to explore health, wellness, fitness and sports performance.
  2. Students will learn to test and analyze components of physical health and fitness across the lifespan. 
  3. Students will prescribe exercise regimens using appropriate methods and techniques to maintain health, encourage wellness and improve sports performance. 
  4. Students will examine ethical practices and conduct scientific inquiry in the field of exercise science.
  5. Students will effectively communicate exercise testing results, lab findings and literature from the field verbally and in writing.
